gigs.name: Àirdan
gigs.description: High-energy music rooted in Scotland and influenced by the world, from Celtic Connections 2026 Battle of the Folk Bands finalists.

gigs.name: Alan Reid & Christine Kydd
gigs.description: A collaboration between two of the finest performers from the Scottish Traditional Hall of Fame, bringing songs old and new.

gigs.name: Iona Fyfe
gigs.description: A multi-award winning singer, tireless advocate for the Scots Leid, with a lively mix of material rooted in the songs of Aberdeenshire.

gigs.name: Pete Morton
gigs.description: An old-time troubadour from Leicester, and an EFC favourite celebrated for his unruly mix of storytelling, humour and song.

gigs.name: George Machray
gigs.description: Celebrated for his comedy songs and parodies, with the odd poignant ballad along the way. An even with the focus on fun.

gigs.name: Judy Barker & Sally Thomas
gigs.description: Songs and tunes from Scotland and England, with English concertina, Scottish smallpipes and beautiful, layered harmonies.
